resources.string: Place traps to reveal players' roles.
Place traps around the map. Players who stay in traps long enough will have their roles revealed to you at the next meeting.

The Revealer is a Crewmate role that can place traps around the map. \%nl\%When players stay in a trap for a certain amount of time, \%nl\%their roles are revealed to the Revealer at the next meeting.
Place a trap at your current location. Players who stay in the trap for the required duration will have their roles revealed to you.
No players were caught in your traps.
Not enough players were caught in your traps.
Place traps on vents. Players who use trapped vents will be immobilized for a duration.
The Trapper is a Crewmate role that can place traps on vents. When players use a trapped vent, they are immobilized for a duration and the Trapper is notified.
Place a trap on a vent. Players who use this vent will be caught and immobilized.
You were caught in a trap in <room>!
Stack your votes and unleash them all at once!
You have a vote bank. Each meeting you can\%nl\%distribute your votes freely among players, or\%nl\%Abstain to save your votes for later meetings.
You can Abstain form voting at a meeting, by doing so you are saving votes that you can then spend all at once, For example 10 votes at one meeting.
You save your votes for later meetings.
You have {0} bank votes (+{1} from Monarch)!
Vanish to track and expose evil players.
Vanish to become invisible and detect impostors and neutrals in your radius.
You are crewmate Swooper. You can Vanish and observe neutrals/impostors.
Turn invisible for a short time. Bad players nearby get a warning. You can reappear early by pressing Unvanish.
You cannot see your task list, task markers, or task locations on the map.
You cannot see your task list, task markers, or task locations on the map. Tasks still spawn normally and count toward the task bar.
You are a child! Grow up to lose your protection.
You are a Child (Age: <age>/<adultAge>).\%nl\%While underage, you cannot be killed.\%nl\%You grow older every few seconds.\%nl\%Once you reach adulthood, you lose your protection.
When you are a child, you are protected from being killed. Once you reach adulthood, you lose your protection.
When you kill someone, their body rots away.
Venomous is a modifier for Neutral Killing roles. When you kill a player, their body will rot away, preventing it from being reported.
Defend <client>. If they get voted out, you lose!
The <color=#EDB38C>Lawyer</color> is a Neutral Benign role that wins by keeping their assigned client from being voted out. If their client gets voted out, the Lawyer loses.
During meetings, click the objection button on your client\'s vote area to object to all votes, clearing them and forcing players to vote again.
After each kill, your kill cooldown is set to\%nl\%a random value between the configured minimum\%nl\%and maximum.
After each kill, the kill cooldown is randomized between the configured minimum and maximum values. Cannot be assigned to Warlock, Outlaw, or Scavenger.
Lawyer Gets Voted Out With Client
Select a player to steal their role at the next meeting.\%nl\%If you target a non-crewmate (unless allowed), you will die.
You can steal a player's role, but if you try to steal an Impostor/Neutral role you will commit suicide instantly.
Select a player to steal their role at the next meeting.
Objection! A lawyer has objected to the current votes! All votes have been cleared - please vote again.
You cannot vote for the same person after an objection!
Kill everyone to win alone.\%nl\%You can kill players in vents, but you'll lose the ability to vent after doing so.

The Serial Killer is a Neutral Killing role whose only objective is to kill everyone and win alone. The Serial Killer can optionally kill players who are in vents with them, but loses the ability to vent for the rest of the game after doing so.
Swallow players to trap them in your stomach.\%nl\%They are digested when a meeting is called.\%nl\%If you die, they escape alive.
You can eat people alive, eat everyone to win! The People in your stomach will die at the beginning of the meeting.
Swallow players. They are in your stomach. Until the meeting is called or you die.
You have been swallowed by Pelican!
You have been released from the Pelican!
Challenge players to Rock-Paper-Scissors duels during meetings.\%nl\%Win enough duels to win the game.
You can duel a player and make them play Rock, Paper, Scissors against you during the next meeting. If you win, they die. If you lose, nothing happens. Draws only count if the option is enabled.
Select a player to duel at the next meeting. During the meeting, you play Rock, Paper, or Scissors against them.
Can't Duel The Same Person Twice In A Row
You are being dueled by the Pirate!
You are jailed! Your duel has been cancelled.
Your duel target is jailed! Duel cancelled.
You can't duel the same person twice in a row.
Trick killers into attacking your clones!
Place clones of other players on the map.%nl%If killing roles eliminate enough clones, you win!%nl%Clones block regular interactions.
The Joker can place clones of chosen player around map. If killing roles eliminate enough clones, you win!
Open a menu to select a player, then place a clone with their appearance at your current location.
Canonize everyone and unleash Divine Judgement!
Canonize all living players, then trigger Judgement to eliminate everyone.
U need to canonize everyone to start Judgement. The <color=#FFD700>Pope</color> wins if all players die to the Judgement.
Approach a player and mark them (canonize). Marked players glow gold only for you. When everyone is marked, you can kill them with Judgement.
Starts a countdown. If it hits zero, everyone except you dies and you win.
The <role> has unleashed Divine Judgement! <time> seconds remain!
The <role> has begun Divine Judgement! <time> seconds until the end!
All players have been canonized! Use Judgement!
After killing, you have a short window to kill a second player without cooldown.
You can perform multiple kills depending on options.
Use your Voodoo Doll to curse players.
Create Voodoo Dolls of players during rounds.\%nl\%You can cycle between Blindness, Mute, and Deafness curses.

The Voodoo Master is an Impostor Support role who can cast voodoo curses on players. You have a Voodoo Doll button and a Cycle button. Select a curse, then click the Voodoo Doll on a player to apply it. Blindness applies immediately. Mute and Deafness apply at the next meeting and last for its duration.
Curse a player with the selected voodoo effect.
Cycle between Blindness, Mute, and Deafness curses.
Cast curses that kill players after meetings.
Cast spells on players.\%nl\%They'll be highlighted in the next meeting and die after the configured amount of meetings.

The Witch is an Impostor Killing role that can cast spells on other players. Spellbound players are highlighted in the next meeting and die after the configured amount of meetings. If the Witch dies, gets exiled, or is guessed, all spellbound players survive.
Cast a spell on a player. They will be highlighted in the next meeting and die after the configured amount of meetings.
<player> has been cursed! They have <meetings> meeting(s) left. Vote out or kill the Witch to save them!
Multiple players have been cursed:\n<players>\nVote out or kill the Witch to save them!
<player> has been cursed by the Gaslighter! They will die at the end of this meeting unless the Gaslighter is voted out!
Multiple players have been cursed by the Gaslighter:\n<players>\nVote out the Gaslighter to save them!
Dash for speed. Place a Lantern to teleport back to it.

The <color=#D62020>Wraith</color> is an Impostor Power role focused on fast, unpredictable movement. Dash increases your movement speed by 75% for a short time. Lantern lets you place a hidden marker only you can see; reactivate it to teleport back and briefly swoop. If the Lantern expires before you return, it breaks and leaves permanent evidence visible to all players.
Temporarily increase your movement speed by 75%.
Place a Lantern only you can see. Reactivate it to teleport back and briefly turn invisible. If it expires, it breaks and leaves evidence visible to everyone.
Download system information and jam comms.
Download and jam equipment, kill for extra jam charges.

The Hacker is an Impostor Support role that can download information from nearby equipment to charge a portable device. Once you start downloading, you're locked into that equipment type until the next round. Jam disrupts information systems (Admin, Cams, etc.) and blocks all players from reporting bodies or calling emergency meetings. The Hacker is the only one who can still use their portable device during Jam or Communications sabotage.
Download data near a console (Admin, Cams, etc.) to charge your battery. You can use the device anywhere afterwards!
Use the downloaded system anywhere, consuming battery over time.

Turn off information systems for a short time (like sabotaging comms). During Jam, Emergency Meetings and Body Reports are disabled for all players, but the Hacker can still use their portable device during this time.
Your shield has been attacked! You have a moment for Backlash!
Steer a bomb-car to destroy the crew.
Deploy an RC car and detonate it near enemies.
The RC-XD is an Impostor Power role that can deploy and detonate an RC-XD car to kill players around the map. Use arrow keys to steer it and detonate near enemies.
Deploy an RC car to steer it towards targets.
Detonate your RC car to kill nearby players.
Phase through walls and return to your start position.
Phase through walls and teleport back. You must kill someone to survive!

The Astral is an Impostor Concealing role that can enter an astral state. In this state, you can walk through walls. When the phase ends, you are teleported back to where you started. If configured, failing to kill someone during the phase will result in your death.
Die if no kill during Phase
Speedy is an Impostor Concealing role that can become camouflaged and fast to kill Crewmates.
Use your ability to gain speed and camouflage yourself. Sneak up on Crewmates!
Speedy is an Impostor Concealing role that can become camouflaged and fast to kill Crewmates.
Attach bombs to players and detonate them at the right moment.
Sneak up on players to attach a bomb. You can detonate it manually after a short delay!

The Detonator is an Impostor role that can attach time bombs to other players. After attaching a bomb, the Detonator can detonate it manually using the same button after a configurable delay. The explosion kills the target and anyone else within the blast radius.
Attach a bomb to a nearby player. Once attached, you can click the button again after the manual delay to detonate it. The explosion will kill multiple people if they are close enough.
Manually detonate the bomb attached to your target. Triggers the explosion immediately.
Complete all tasks to disable sabotages.
Finish all of your tasks. Once you do, sabotages cannot be called while you are alive.

The Forestaller is a Crewmate Support role that can prevent sabotages before they happen. After completing all tasks, sabotages are disabled while the Forestaller is alive. The Forestaller is revealed after finishing their last task.
Forestaller has completed all tasks. Sabotages are now disabled.
Blind the killers and expose them!
Activate Blind to flash all killing roles. Verify players to check if they are killers.
Your ability allows you to blind all killing roles making them unable to kill, and making everybody look the same. During Evoke you can may verify if a person is in fact a killer or not.
Blind all killers. They won't be able to see or use any skills, including killing.
While Flash is activated u may verify players. If your screen flashes red this person is killing role.
Inject players with beneficial effects\%nl\%to aid the Crew.
Inject players to give them beneficial effects.\%nl\%If configured, injections may occasionally cause negative effects.

The Doctor is a Crewmate role that can inject players with various beneficial effects. Effects are randomly selected and can include speed boosts, vision increases, cleansing negative effects, or applying a one-time protective shield.
Inject a nearby player with a random beneficial effect. The effect will activate after a configurable delay.
You were protected by the Doctor's shield!
Your eyesight has returned to normal.
Prime a decoy, then place it. If anyone interacts with it, it vanishes and you are notified.

The Mirage is a Crewmate Support role that can place a decoy with the appearance of a chosen target (yourself or a random player). If any player interacts with the decoy, it disappears instantly and both the Mirage and the toucher receive a notification. Note: Mirage cannot be guessed if the decoy has the appearance of yourself.
Prime a clone, and click again to place it. If anyone touches it, you will be notified.
Inject players to give them random effects.

The Injector is an Impostor Support role that can inject players with various negative effects. Effects are randomly selected and can include inverted controls, reduced vision, slowness, or confusion.
Inject a nearby player with a random negative effect. The effect will activate after a configurable delay.
Your vision has returned to normal.
The speed boost has worn off.
Your vision has returned to normal.
Manipulate body reports to your advantage.
Use Deceive to report bodies you've killed from any distance.\%nl\%Use Conceal to reduce the report range of nearby bodies.

The Charlatan is an Impostor Support role that manipulates body reports. Deceive allows you to report bodies you've killed from any distance for a limited time after killing. Conceal reduces the report range of nearby bodies, but requires you to stay near the body for the duration.
Report the body you just killed from anywhere on the map.
Make it so nobody can report this body. You must stand near it to hide it.
Eat dead bodies to win alone.
Eat dead bodies to win alone.

The Vulture is a Neutral Evil role whose goal is to eat a set amount of dead bodies. Optionally, the Vulture can use Scavenge to get arrows pointing to corpses. If the Vulture\'s win condition can no longer be met, they become the configured role.
Eat a nearby dead body. This counts toward your win condition.
Get arrows pointing to all corpses for a duration. If a corpse is on a different floor on Submerged, the arrow will point to the elevator.
Punish those who vote you out.
When you are voted out, everyone who voted for you receives a negative effect.
When you are voted out, everyone who voted for you receives a negative effect.
The player you voted for was <spiteful>! <effect>
Your ability cooldowns are increased by <impact>%
Hunt your assigned targets to victory.
You need to murder your targets to win!
Kill your assigned target. You cannot kill any other player.

You failed to kill your target! Cooldown penalty applied.
You have successfully completed your bounties as the <color=#B0BEC5>Bounty Hunter</color>! You will now spectate and win with the winning team.
The <color=#B0BEC5>Bounty Hunter</color>, <player>, has completed all their bounties!
Poison enemies or trap them with vines.
Use Poison to slowly kill players you approach.\%nl\%Use Vine to remotely kill the nearest player in range.
An Impostor who can poison players on contact or use vines to kill from a distance.
Approach a player and poison them. They will die after a delay.
Find the nearest player in range and kill them after a delay. Your camera follows the target.
Mark players and strike from the shadows.
Mark a player to shroud them.\%nl\%If they are killed or voted out, you win!\%nl\%You can also kill players directly.
The Shroud is a Neutral Killing role. You can mark a player to shroud them. If your shrouded target dies, you win. You also have a normal kill ability.
Mark a player. If they die, you win.
Protect your target! Your shield now reacts to all kill attempts.
Shield a player from attacks. When they are attacked, teleport to them and eliminate the threat.

Gives a shield to a player. The shield reacts to all kill attempts (including Crewmate Killing roles like Sheriff). If someone tries to kill the protected player, the Bodyguard can teleport to them and eliminate the attacker. You can only kill the attacker, and if you do, you die along with them (Sacrifice is absolute and ignores all shields).
Give someone a shield. If someone attacks them, you will be able to teleport to them.
Click to teleport to the attacked teammate and kill the attacker.
After teleporting via Backlash, kill a nearby player. Depending on options, you can only target the attacker or anyone nearby.
Dark Blue Name On Who Attacked
Your movement controls are inverted for {meetings} meetings.
The Drunk has their movement controls permanently inverted for {meetings} meetings. They cannot be guessed.
Soar above and see the bigger picture.
Zoom out to observe the map from a bird's eye view.
You can zoom out the screen for a few seconds. You can't use this at light sabotage.
Zoom out the camera to see a wider area for a limited duration. Cannot be used during lights sabotage.
Use your intuition to discover who is working together.
Use Gaze and Intuit on two different players, then learn if they are allies or enemies.
You are a very wise person, that can tell if two people win or lose together.
Select the first player to compare.
Select the second player to compare. If a Gaze target is already set, the comparison will trigger.
A Crewmate modifier that grants limited access to vents. You have a set number of vent uses with a cooldown between each use and a maximum duration per vent stay.
Kill players to steal their appearance.\%nl\%You remain disguised until a meeting is called.\%nl\%Once out of steals, you can still kill but won't disguise.
If u kill a player u will steal his identity for the rest of the round.
Write their name... and they die.
Find the Death Note near a vent. Write a player's name to curse them with a delayed death.
The Death Note has been used.
The Death Note is spawning on random vent. If u find it, u can write a player's name to curse them. They will die of a Heart Attack after the timer expires.
Find the Death Note near a random vent and write the name of a living player. After the configured timer expires, that player dies of a Heart Attack. The Death Note is consumed immediately after use.
Mark players with a deadly trap.
Shroud a player to set a trap. Anyone who interacts with them dies.\%nl\%If no one interacts, the shrouded player dies after the meeting is called.

The Shroud can mark one player per round with a deadly trap. Any player who interacts with the shrouded player will be killed instead. If no one interacts with the shrouded player before a meeting is called, the shrouded player dies shortly after the meeting begins.
Mark a player as a trap. Anyone who interacts with them dies. If no one does before the meeting, the marked player dies right after.
Use your stake to kill Vampires.\%nl\%Failed stakes on non-Vampires are wasted.\%nl\%When all Vampires die, you become a new role.

The Vampire Hunter spawns only when Vampires are in the game. After the first meeting, a random Crewmate is converted into the Vampire Hunter. They can stake players if the player is a Vampire, they die. If not, the stake is used. When all Vampires are eliminated, the Vampire Hunter converts into another Crewmate role.
Stake a nearby player. If they are a Vampire, they die. If not, you waste a stake use.
Self Kill On All Stakes Failed
Sacrifice yourself in a massive explosion and take your enemies down with you!
Sacrifice yourself in an explosion to kill all nearby players.

The Kamikaze is an Impostor role that can detonate themselves, killing all players within the blast radius. The Kamikaze dies in the process. Use the regular kill button normally, and activate the suicide button when the moment is right to take out as many enemies as possible.
Blow yourself up! You will kill everyone around you, but you will also die.
You can see color votes of others during meetings.
You can see the color votes of all players during meetings.
See the real color votes of all players during meetings.

TOUMCE Symbols Glossary • Θ - Player canonized by Pope • ♢ - Player set as trap by the Shroud • ♡ - Player entered in Death Note • Σ - Player shielded by the Bodyguard • % - Player poisoned by the Poisoner • § - Lawyer's client

When a kill is blocked by a shield, the killer sees a colored flash indicating which role provided the protection: • Dark Green - Medic • Purple - Warden • Cyan/Teal - Cleric • Silver Blue - Mirrorcaster • Light Blue - Fairy • Mauve - Mercenary • Dark Blue - Bodyguard • Magenta - Oracle (meeting protection)

Draft Mode replaces normal role assignment with a strategic pick phase before the game starts. • Players are assigned a side (Crewmate, Impostor, or Neutral) and then choose their specific role in a randomized turn order. • Each player is offered 3 unique roles. Spectators are excluded from the process and do not take up pick slots. • If you do not pick in time, a role will be automatically assigned to you based on your assigned side. • By default, all players draft from the complete pool of enabled roles for their side (Crewmate, Impostor, or Neutral). Restrictive categories have been removed for a more flexible experience.

Before the draft begins, players are assigned a faction that determines their available role pool. • Impostors draft from the full pool of available Impostor roles. • Crewmates choose from the full pool of available Crewmate roles. If Other Neutrals (Benign, Evil, or Outlier) are enabled in the lobby, these roles will be mixed into the Crewmate's choice pool until global targets are met. • Neutral Killing draft from available killing factions. • Global Targets - Lobby settings control the Min/Max number of players assigned to Neutral Killing and Other Neutral (Benign/Evil/Outlier) factions. • 60/40 Logic - The system uses a weighted probability to favor minimum targets while allowing for occasional maximums to keep games unpredictable. Drafting follows individual role chances if "Use Role Chances" is enabled, using a Weighted Shuffle. If Neutrals Per Choice is configured, the number of Neutral roles shown per turn can be strictly limited (this setting applies to Crewmates only).
This section contains advanced options for existing roles and modifiers, enhancing their abilities and gameplay mechanics.

Vampires have advanced sabotage options: • Only Lights - The Vampire can only sabotage the Electrical system via the TAB map. • Shared Cooldown - Vampires share the same global sabotage timer with Impostors. • Only OG - Sabotage can be restricted to the original Vampire only (bitten vampires cannot sabotage).
Configure extension options for existing roles and modifiers here!

TOUMCE introduces several global settings that change the game flow: • Lock Lobby During Draft - Prevents new players from joining while a draft is in progress to ensure stability. • System of Thirds - A balanced pick order that distributes Impostors and Neutrals evenly across the beginning, middle, and end of the draft phase. • Use Role Chances - If enabled, the probability of roles appearing in the Draft will be based on their individual 'Chance' settings in the lobby. • Neutrals Per Choice - Controls how many Neutral roles are mixed into each Crewmate's selection pool. • Global Neutral Limits - Hard limits for the total number of Neutral roles (NK and others) allowed in a single round. • Reduce Killing Streak - Decreases the chance of players becoming a killing role again if they were one in the previous round. • Impostor / Neutral Killing - Specific reduction chances for each major killing faction.
Manipulate others' perceptions and win by survival.
Use your abilities to confuse and mark players.\%nl\%If you survive until the end, you win!
The Gaslighter is a Neutral role that wins by surviving. They have a cycle of abilities including Knighting and Cursing players.
Hide underground and strike from below.
Dig underground to move freely and become a real sandworm.\%nl\%Emerge to kill players when they least expect it.
The Sandworm is an Impostor that can dig underground. While underground, they are invisible and can move through walls (if enabled). They must emerge to kill.
Stun your victims with high-voltage charges.
Zap players to stun them and prevent them from moving or reporting.
The Zapper is an Impostor who can stun players for a short duration.
Cause chaos by scrambling player roles.
Use your ability to temporarily scramble role symbols and names for others.
The Confuser is an Impostor who can scramble role information during meetings or in-game.
Freeze the game with your icy touch.
Freeze players or trigger a Blizzard to slow everyone down.
The Icenberg is a Neutral role that can freeze players and create blizzards.
Take control of another player after your death.
As a ghost, possess a living player to control their movements and abilities.
The Possessor is an Impostor Afterlife role. After death, they can possess a living player.
You are both dead and alive. Join the team that finds you first.
You start as Neutral. The first team to interact with you becomes your team.
Schrodinger's Cat is a Neutral role that joins the team of the first person who interacts with them.
Protect the crew with your watchful eye.
Place a patrol zone to monitor for Impostor activity.
The Sentinel is a Crewmate who can place patrol zones that detect killers.
Put any bodies in your bag to take with you!
The Dumper is an Impostor who can drag bodies and dump them elsewhere.
Kill from a distance and teleport to your victim.
You can kill from a much larger distance. When you kill, you teleport to the body.
The Sniper modifier allows the holder to kill from a distance and automatically teleport to the victim's location.
Consume your enemies in the void of a black hole.
Place a black hole that pulls players toward its center and obliterates them.
The Abyssbringer is an Impostor Power role. They can spawn a black hole that pulls nearby players. Anyone who reaches the center is obliterated.
Spawn a black hole at your current position.
Dig underground to become invisible and move through walls.
Select a player to turn them into a bomb.\%nl\%They will explode after a short delay.
Burst is an Impostor Killing role that can mark a player as a "ticking bomb". After a configured delay, the player explodes and dies. The Burst can cancel the process before it finishes.
Select a player to start the timer. If it reaches 0, they explode.
Cancel the active burst and reset the timer.
Give bread to others. Transform into Famine.
Give bread to players. Once enough players have bread, you will transform into Famine.
Give bread to players. Once enough players have bread, you will transform into Famine.
Mark players to starve them to death at the next meeting. You cannot be killed.
Mark players using the Starve button. They will starve at the start of the next meeting. You are immune to normal kills.
Mark players using the Starve button. They will starve at the start of the next meeting. You are immune to normal kills.
Mark a player to starve at the next meeting.
Drag a dead body and dump it elsewhere to hide the crime scene. Moving a body makes you slower.
Throw spinning axes that slice through the map.
Throw a tomahawk in the direction of the nearest player.\%nl\%It travels through the whole map, killing anyone it hits.

Tomahawk is an Impostor Killing role that throws a spinning axe. The axe travels in a straight line toward the nearest player at the moment of throwing. Anyone caught in its radius is sliced and dies.
Place a remote-controlled C4 bomb and detonate it.
Place a bomb on the ground.\%nl\%Detonate it at any time to kill players in the explosion radius.

C4 is an Impostor Power role that can drop a remote-controlled explosive package (C4) on the floor. The bomb can then be detonated at any moment from anywhere, executing any crewmates caught within the blast zone.
Place the C4 bomb on the ground at your feet.
Trigger the explosion of your placed C4 bomb.
Create a powerful shockwave blast that pushes players off the map!
Use your shockwave blast to throw nearby players through walls and into the void!

Shockwave is an Impostor Support role that can trigger a massive shockwave. Any players within the blast zone are flung outward, passing through walls and flying off the map, where they are consumed by the void after 5 seconds.
Trigger a shockwave blast around yourself.
Acquire targets and eliminate them through solid walls with your high-caliber rifle!
Activate your scope to see through walls. Left-click any crewmate within range and line-of-sight to snipe them!
Sniper is an Impostor Killing role that can enter tactical Scope Mode. While scoping, the Sniper can see through walls and can eliminate any crewmate in range by clicking on them with the mouse.
Toggle Sniper Scope Mode on or off.
Gain a new Impostor role after every single kill!
Every successful kill will change your role into another lethal Impostor archetype from the weapon chain!

Gun Game is an Impostor Power role that changes into a completely new Impostor role after every kill. The sequence of changes can follow a fixed weapon chain (Sniper -> RC-XD -> Detonator -> Vanilla Impostor) or be chosen completely at random.
Deploy temporary structures to block paths and protect your crew!
Choose between placing a crate or a wall, then deploy it to seal off corridors and block player movement.
Builder is a Crewmate Support role that can build temporary solid physics obstacles (Crates and Walls) that block the movement of all players. Structures naturally dissipate after a short duration.
Cycle your active structure between Crate and Wall.
Intercept security console systems to track player activity.
You receive live notifications whenever any player uses or leaves a security/surveillance console (Admin, Cams, Vitals, Door Logs).

Telecommunication is a Crewmate Investigative role that intercepts signals from administrative and security consoles on the ship. You are instantly notified whenever any player begins or ends their session on Cameras, the Admin Map, Vitals, or Door Logs.
Buy beer, drink alcohol and use powerful dad abilities to help the crew!
You must maintain your alcohol level by buying beer from the shop (random vent). Jump into other vents to activate selected abilities.

Dad is a Crewmate Support role. He has an alcohol level that constantly decreases. If it hits zero, Dad dies of sobriety. He earns money for beer by completing tasks. The shop is located in a random vent. Hopping into a normal vent triggers the currently active ability.
Dad went for milk... He might return in 10 years.
Rage active! Collision with a player will murder them!
Became the God of Alcohol! Alcohol starts rising!
You feel very dizzy... Your role feels like a...
Set up fake dead bodies as deadly traps for the crew.
Place decoy fake dead bodies. Anyone who attempts to report a decoy will be instantly eaten/killed.
Body Swapper is an Impostor Killing role that can place fake dead bodies using the Decoy button. Reporting a decoy instantly kills the reporter instead of starting a meeting.
Haunt the living with fake bodies to win from the afterlife.
Place decoy fake bodies. Each time someone tries to report your decoy, you earn a point towards your victory!

Poltergeist is a Neutral Afterlife role. You are a ghost walker (like the Spectre). You have no tasks; instead, you can spawn decoy dead bodies using the Decoy button. If a player reports your decoy, you gain a point. Accumulate the required points to win!
Swap places with a player and play cat and mouse. If they can't catch you, they die!
Use Swap to teleport to a player's position (and them to yours).\%nl\%The target must find and kill you before time runs out, or they die!\%nl\%Survive to the end with at least one swap to win.

The Quarry is a Neutral Outlier role. Use the Swap ability to exchange positions with another player, starting a cat-and-mouse game. The swapped target receives a notification and screen flash, and must find and kill The Quarry before the seek timer expires. If the timer runs out, the target dies. The Quarry cannot kill their current seek target, but can kill other players. Survive to the end of the game with at least one successful swap to win alongside whoever wins.
Open a player selection menu and swap positions with the chosen player. Starts a seek timer.
Kill a nearby player. Cannot kill the current seek target.
Kill The Quarry during seek time to survive.
You have been swapped by The Quarry! Find and kill them!
Manipulate the crew with your unique abilities.
At the start of every meeting, you are assigned a random ability (Kill, Knight, Shield, or Curse). Use your action button on players to decide their fate!

Gaslighter is a Neutral Outlier role. Instead of a single fixed ability, they receive one of four random powers at the start of each meeting: Kill (25%), Knight (25%), Shield (25%), or Curse (25%). Use your action button to apply your chosen effect to a player. Survive to fulfill your chosen win condition!
Use your randomly assigned ability for this round.
Get into position, aim, and shoot (by clicking with your mouse on a player) to eliminate your target from a distance!

Sniper is an Impostor Ranged role. They have a special Aim button that immobilizes them for a few seconds and increases their vision, allowing them to see through walls. While aiming, they can use the Shoot button - simply click on a player with your mouse to shoot them! If they die, miss, or run out of time, aiming is canceled.
Throw a spinning axe that travels across the map.
Enter Aim mode to see through walls and click your mouse to throw the Tomahawk in that direction!

Tomahawk is an Impostor Killing role that throws a spinning axe. They have a special Aim button that immobilizes them for 5 seconds and increases their vision, letting them see through walls. Just left click with your mouse to throw the tomahawk in any direction! Anyone in its path will be killed instantly.
Enter aim mode. Then left-click to throw your axe.
Get rid of evidence - teleport bodies to random locations on the map!
Boot is an Impostor Support role. You have a special Boot button that you can use to target a nearby dead body and teleport it to a completely random, safe location on the map!

Boot is an Impostor Support that has a body teleportation button (Boot). It allows a targeted body to instantly disappear and reappear in a completely different spot on the map! Bodies never spawn in walls or outside the map boundaries.
Use Taunt on another player to make them immediately kill you.\%nl\%If that player is voted out in the next meeting, you win.

Innocent is a Neutral Evil role. Use Taunt on another player to make them immediately kill you. If that player is voted out in the next meeting, you win. To assist you in meetings, a special symbol will appear next to the killer's name (only visible to you).
Taunt a player into killing you.
Your role returns fake/scrambled information to you!
You have the Insane modifier. Your role behaves in reverse or shows incorrect data.
Insane is a universal passive modifier that can be assigned to any player. When active, it scrambles, reverses, or interferes with the information provided by the player's role.
Disorient your targets to flip their view and controls!
Inverter is an Impostor Support role. You have a special Disorient button that you can use to choose a target and flip their screen upside-down and invert their controls!
Inverter is an Impostor Support role that can choose a target to disorient. When disoriented, the target's screen is flipped upside-down, and their movement controls are completely inverted.
Disorient a player, flipping their screen upside-down and inverting their movement controls.
Mark players and collect their souls after death to win!
Use the Reap button to mark living players. When a marked player dies, their soul will spawn. Collect the required number of souls using the Collect button to win.

Grim Reaper is a Neutral Evil role. They have two abilities: Reap and Collect. Use Reap to mark a living player. When a marked player dies, a soul is spawned at their body. Use Collect to harvest the soul. Collecting the target number of souls grants victory.
Mark a living player. When they die, they will leave a collectable soul behind.
Collect a nearby soul left by a deceased marked player.
Place clones of other players to fool killers into attacking them!
Use your Place Clone button to spawn a static decoy of another player. If killing roles attack your clones enough times, you win!

Joker is a Neutral Evil role. They can place a static decoy clone of any player on the map. If killing roles attempt to attack the clone, they are fooled (putting their ability on cooldown without hurting anyone), and the Joker gets closer to victory. Depending on the settings, the Joker wins either immediately (Solo Win) or dies and wins alongside the winning team.
Place a clone of a player on the map. If killing roles kill enough clones, you win!
